events.note: Performer stands at the start of the run-up, side-on to the camera, shelf and blue crash mat ahead.
Starts running along +X toward the shelf.
Last strides before the shelf, torso leaning forward, arms swinging up.
Drives off the left foot about 1 m before the shelf; roll begins.
Rising over the front edge of the shelf, about 90 degrees into the roll, arms tucked.
Inverted (about 180 degrees) above the shelf top and the plants.
About 270 degrees, descending past the far edge of the shelf.
Roll complete; lands on both feet and hands near the centre of the crash mat.
Absorbs the landing in a crouch on the mat.
Stands up on the mat and holds still.

summary: A complete barrel roll over the shelf with a clean landing on the crash mat. The run-up reads well and the roll is centred over the shelf; the arms stay rather rigid through the rotation and the feet slide on the mat after touchdown.

timing.notes: Flight is shown at about half speed in the slow-motion segment; at real speed the 0.9 s flight is plausible for a 1.9 m apex.

unnatural_motion.issue: Arms stay locked at the same angle through the whole roll, slightly robotic.
Both feet slide about 30 cm on the mat after touchdown while the knees are bent.

framing.notes: Whole body visible from the run start to the settle; the performer is about 25 percent of the frame height.

proposed_changes.reason: 5.2 s: feet slide on the mat after touchdown; a softer landing should stop the skid.
4.2 s: rigid arms through the roll; pulling them in reads more athletic.
